newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA says shareholders deserve better.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA says shareholders deserve better.

text.p: AWA Ltd said on Thursday its restructuring should give investors the chance of receiving higher returns.

The company, which earlier announced the planned A$25 million sale of its communications, aerospace and traffic division to Plessey Corp Ltd of South Africa, said the restructuring had been completed and the focus would be on its profitable gaming and wagering division.
AWA also announced the resignation of managing director John Dougall and a smaller annual loss.

"The strong financial structure of the company provides an excellent base for the group to pursue opportunities, particularly in relation to AWA Gaming and Wagering," new managing director John Rouse said in a statement accompanying the results.

"In line with the continued successful execution of the company's strategic direction, AWA's focus on fewer businesses will provide an opportunity to increase returns for the benefit of shareholders." AWA's net loss in 1995/96 was A$14.26 million from a loss of A$22.16 million a year earlier.
